claim_limit: Two-sided bounds from monotone comparisons, uniformisation with an added Poisson tail, exact dyadic time steps, decimal (50-digit) exponentials, weights and payoffs with conservative conversion, and an outward relative factor 1e-13 per floating-point operator step; the rounding argument (enclose_core.py docstring and manuscript Section 7.1) covers p = 0, N <= 2000, steps <= 1/64 and assumes IEEE-754 binary64 arithmetic with correctly rounded basic operations. Written out, not machine-checked.
